title: shellPlaywrightConfig
responsibility: Runs isolated explorer-shell browser checks with visible scrollbars, without an application server, seeded history or application build.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: The default Playwright test configuration for the explorer shell specs: tests in ../../tests/e2e whose file name starts with explorer-shell and ends in .spec.ts, one worker, the list reporter, results in ../../test-results/explorer-shell, screenshots only on failure, and the browser launched without --hide-scrollbars. It starts no web server and seeds nothing: the specs build their fixture pages and answer requests from those files.
